Knowledge distillation is a technique used in machine learning to create a smaller, faster model that can mimic the performance of a larger, more complex model. The process involves training a smaller, simpler model (the student) to learn from the output of a larger, more complex model (the teacher) that has already been trained on the same task. The student model is trained to minimize the difference between its own predictions and the teacher's predictions, which are used as a form of "distilled" knowledge.
